connector.name: x402 Wallet
connector.registryDescription: Self-custodial x402 wallet for AI agents: pay any service in USDC or $THREE from your own key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package x402-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SOLANA_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Base58 (or JSON byte-array) Solana secret key that signs payments and holds the USDC. Not needed for the read tools (find_services, inspect_endpoint, or x402_wallet with an explicit address). Treat like cash.

env.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
env.description: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint. Defaults to the public cluster — bring your own (Helius / Quicknode / Triton) for production traffic.

env.name: MAX_PAY_USD
env.description: Max USD a single pay_and_call may spend. Bounds a runaway or injected payment.

env.name: REQUIRE_CONFIRM
env.description: When on (default), pay_and_call refuses until re-issued with confirm:true. Set 0/false to disable the gate.

env.name: THREE_WS_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves /api/bazaar/search for find_services. Override only when self-hosting.
